deduplication_rule: rownames must be unique; duplicate source rows are rejected
grouping_rule: first 64 ordered rows fit the reference and final 33 rows form the held-out calibration likelihood
known_source_dependence: serial dependence is expected; the worked demonstrator uses a fixed conditional likelihood and the linked scientific case study evaluates temporal dependence explicitly
license_status: The official wooldridge data package distributes fish as package content and declares GPL-3. This CSV is conveyed separately under GPL-3 to the extent that package licence applies. The Rdatasets underlying-rights caveat is retained.
processed_filename: not_persisted; the deterministic split and transformed values are written in the generated output
redistribution_decision: Bundled as a separately licensed GPL-3 fixture to the extent applicable, with source attribution, the complete GPL-3 text, and the Rdatasets underlying-rights caveat.
retrieval_method: byte-identical Rdatasets CSV serialization of the fish table distributed by the official wooldridge package
retrieval_timestamp_utc: unknown: the exact upstream retrieval time was not retained; byte identity is fixed by SHA256
rights_basis: The official GPL-3 wooldridge package distributes the fish table as package content; the CSV is the Rdatasets serialization of that table.
selection_rule: all 97 ordered complete rows are retained; the first 64 train and final 33 are held out
source_citation: K. Graddy, Testing for Imperfect Competition at the Fulton Fish Market, RAND Journal of Economics 26 (1995), 75-92; Rdatasets wooldridge::fish export
